author: Ashley Roberts
text: There is no needle inside, that scary needle was to pock your arm to insert a soft sensor, and that soft sensor will come out when you detach the round external part. That needle was left in the plastic you threw away,

author: Steve Kuckuk
text: There is no needle left inside your body, the needle (small knife) is retract into the applicator when finished… What is inserted under the skin is a small very flexible filament, when you take the first one off, you’ll be able to touch and bend the filament and see for yourself what I’m talking about.
